title: AI-71 Capability Request
description: Stable, provider-neutral capability request envelope. The request never carries provider, model, profile, or credential fields; the schema rejects such fields and the validator at src/capabilities/validation.ts enforces the same rule on top of the schema.

request_id.description: Stable per-invocation identifier chosen by the caller.

capability_id.description: Stable, vendor-neutral dotted identifier. Rejects provider or model names.

schema_version.description: Contract schema version. The MAJOR component must be supported; the runtime validator at src/capabilities/validation.ts enforces this rule in addition to the schema.

input.description: Capability-specific input. The shape is validated by the JSON Schema referenced at CapabilityDefinition.input_schema_ref. Bare arrays are rejected at the request boundary.

context.description: Per-invocation context. Every field is optional because not every caller knows every fact; the contract does not require fabrication.

allOf.description: Reject provider/credential field names anywhere in the request. The contract is provider-neutral; leaking such fields at the request boundary is a fail-closed violation.
